en: Watch out for rabbits wandering around the farmyard. They are hungry and will look for flags, as they often mean hidden food! If a rabbit eats the seed under a flag, you will not get any points for it and will lose the flag.
zh-tw: 小心在農場院子裡徘徊的兔子。牠們很餓，會尋找旗幟，因為那通常代表著隱藏的食物！如果兔子吃掉了旗幟下的種子，你將無法獲得任何分數並失去該旗幟。

en: You can improve your Hunter skill by finding ogleroots in the farmyard and feeding them to the rabbits. Ogleroots are magical vegetables and will cause the rabbit to disappear for a short amount of time.
zh-tw: 你可以透過在農場院子裡尋找 Og之根並餵給兔子來提升你的狩獵技能。Og之根是魔法蔬菜，會讓兔子在短時間內消失。
農夫布林金的清掃員指南

en: 1. Speak to either Mrs. Winkin in the barn or Farmer Blinkin outside to buy some flags.
zh-tw: 1. 與穀倉裡的溫金夫人或戶外的農夫布林金交談以購買一些旗幟。

en: 2. When you have some flags, head out into the farmyard area over any of the 4 stiles.
zh-tw: 2. 當你擁有了一些旗幟後，越過任何一個踏步前往農場院子區域。

en: 3. Use your spade to dig up any of the holes around the farmyard. This will uncover what was in that hole. The aim is to place your flags in holes where you believe seeds are planted.
zh-tw: 3. 使用你的鏟子挖掘農場院子周圍的任何洞穴。這將揭露該洞穴中的內容物。目標是將你的旗幟放置在你認為種植了種子的洞穴中。

en: 4. If the hole has nothing in it, then it will uncover a radius of 2 holes in all directions
zh-tw: 4. 如果洞穴中空無一物，則會揭露所有方向半徑為 2 個洞穴的範圍。

en: 5. If you uncover a number from 1-8, this means that there are that many seeds planted in the 8 holes surrounding the one that you have dug up.
zh-tw: 5. 如果你揭露了 1 到 8 之間的數字，這代表在你挖掘的洞穴周圍的 8 個洞穴中有該數量的種子被種植。

en: 6. When you have a square that you are certain contains a seed, either right-click and select the 'Flag' option or use a flag on the hole.
zh-tw: 6. 當你確定有一個正方形區域包含種子時，點擊右鍵並選擇「旗幟」選項，或在洞穴上使用旗幟。

en: 7. When a farmer sees a flag, he will come over to check beneath it. He will collect the flag and give points out if there was a seed there. If you have successfully found a seed, you will be able to get the flag back for free from either Mrs. Winkin or Farmer Blinkin.
zh-tw: 7. 當農夫看到旗幟時，他會過來檢查旗幟下方。如果那裡有種子，他會收走旗幟並發放分數。如果你成功找到了種子，你可以從溫金夫人或農夫布林金那裡免費拿回旗幟。

en: 8. Rabbits roam the area and will attempt to eat seeds where flags are planted or where they have been dug up. Use the ogleroots that you find on them to make them disappear.
zh-tw: 8. 兔子會在該區域徘徊，並會嘗試吃掉放置了旗幟或已被挖掘出的種子。使用你發現的 Og之根讓牠們消失。

en: Trade points for seeds and flags
zh-tw: 使用點數兌換種子與旗幟

en: Are you sure you want to trade your remaining points for XP?
zh-tw: 您確定要將剩餘的點數兌換為經驗值嗎？

en: Use a spade to dig in the farmer's field and try to work out where the seeds have been planted. Try not to dig up the seeds, as this will lose you points! Usually, when you dig a square, you will uncover a number, which shows how many seeds are in the holes next to it.
zh-tw: 使用鏟子在農夫的田地裡挖掘，試著找出種子被種在哪裡。盡量不要挖到種子，否則你會失去分數！通常當你挖掘一個方格時，會發現一個數字，這顯示了旁邊洞穴中有多少顆種子。

en: Plant your flags in holes where you think that seeds may be found. If you are correct, you will get lots of points, but if you are wrong, you will lose the flag. If you are close to other players, you might get some points if they find seeds, too!"
zh-tw: 將你的旗幟插在你想找尋種子的洞穴中。如果你猜對了，你會獲得大量分數；但如果你猜錯了，你會失去該面旗幟。如果你靠近其他玩家，若他們也找到了種子，你也可能會獲得一些分數！

en: While you are in the area, you will be able to see your points total in the top-right corner of your screen. Your points are saved, so you can leave if you wish and return another time to pick up from where you left off.
zh-tw: 當你在該區域時，你可以在螢幕的右上角看到你的總分數。你的分數會被儲存，所以如果你想離開，可以隨時離開並在下次回來時從上次中斷的地方繼續。

en: You can trade your points in for prizes or Farming experience by speaking to Mrs. Winkin in the Winkin shop.
zh-tw: 你可以透過與溫金商店裡的溫金夫人交談，將你的分數兌換成獎品或農耕經驗值。

en: Farmers wander the area looking for seeds that have been dug up by mistake. They will also collect any flags you have placed, resetting the nearby area and giving you points if the flag is in the right place.
zh-tw: 農夫們在該區域徘徊，尋找被誤挖出的種子。他們也會收集你放置的任何旗幟，重置附近的區域，若旗幟位置正確，則會給你分數。

en: If you place a flag over a seed, you will be able to get the flag back from Mrs. Winkin or Farmer Blinkin. If you placed a flag wrongly, you will have to pay 500gp for a new one.
zh-tw: 如果你在種子上放置了旗幟，你可以向溫金夫人或農夫布林金拿回該面旗幟。如果你放錯了旗幟，你必須支付 500gp 來購買新的。

en: However nice your friend is in RuneScape, they are still a stranger to you in real life. We would suggest that you have fun and enjoy the player's company in-game, but leave it there. If you are at all concerned, speak to a parent, friend or adult that you trust.
zh-tw: 無論你的朋友在 RuneScape 中有多友善，在現實生活中他們對你來說仍然是陌生人。我們建議你在遊戲中盡情享受與玩家相處的樂趣，但僅止於此。如果你感到任何擔憂，請向父母、朋友或你信任的成年人傾訴。

en: Be polite and say no, but if the other player is persistent you can use the report abuse button and ignore functions, which can both be found at the bottom of your game window. If you are at all concerned, speak to a parent, friend or adult that you trust.
zh-tw: 保持禮貌並拒絕，但如果另一位玩家堅持不懈，你可以使用遊戲視窗底部的檢舉濫用按鈕和忽略功能。如果你感到任何擔憂，請向父母、朋友或你信任的成年人傾訴。

en: A friend you met playing RuneScape has asked to meet you in real life. What should you do?
zh-tw: 一位你在玩 RuneScape 時認識的朋友要求在現實生活中與你見面。你該怎麼做？

en: Meet them. They've been a friend in-game for a while now and they're really nice
zh-tw: 與他們見面。他們在遊戲中已經當了一段時間的朋友，而且人真的很好

en: Say no and do not meet them
zh-tw: 說不並不要與他們見面

en: This naughty gublinchette gave a player her email address. The wise player hit the Report Abuse button straight away, allowing us to catch her!
zh-tw: 這個頑皮的小葛布林奇給了一位玩家她的電子郵件地址。聰明的玩家立刻按下了檢舉濫用按鈕，讓我們成功抓到了她！

en: A player has started to ask you personal questions that make you feel uncomfortable and you'd rather not answer. What should you do?
zh-tw: 一位玩家開始問你一些讓你感到不舒服且不想回答的個人問題。你該怎麼做？

en: Do not answer any questions and report the player using the Report Abuse button at the bottom of the game screen.
zh-tw: 不要回答任何問題，並使用遊戲畫面底部的檢舉濫用按鈕來檢舉該玩家。

en: If you are at all concerned, speak to a parent, friend or adult that you trust.
zh-tw: 如果你有任何疑慮，請與父母、朋友或你信任的成年人談談。

en: If another player makes you feel uncomfortable by asking lots of personal questions, you can report them using the Report Abuse button. You can also use the ignore function, which can be found at the bottom of your game window.
zh-tw: 如果另一位玩家透過詢問大量個人問題讓你感到不舒服，你可以使用檢舉濫用按鈕來檢舉他們。你也可以使用忽略功能，該功能可以在你的遊戲視窗底部找到。

en: A player has just asked you for your personal details, including your phone number, home address and email address. What should you do?
zh-tw: 一位玩家剛剛向你索取個人資料，包括你的電話號碼、住家地址和電子郵件地址。你該怎麼做？

en: Say "No" and ask for their details instead
zh-tw: 說「不」，並反過來詢問他們的資料

en: Be polite and say no, but if the other player is persistent you can also use the report abuse button and ignore functions, which can both be found at the bottom of your game window. If you are at all concerned, speak to a parent, friend or adult that you trust.
zh-tw: 有禮貌地說不，但如果另一位玩家糾纏不休，你也可以使用檢舉濫用按鈕和忽略功能，這兩者都可以在你的遊戲視窗底部找到。如果你有任何疑慮，請與父母、朋友或你信任的成年人談談。

en: Giving out personal information to another player is dangerous, as you can never be sure who you are talking to. It's best to keep your personal details to yourself.
zh-tw: 向另一位玩家透露個人資訊是危險的，因為你永遠無法確定你在跟誰說話。最好將你的個人資料保留給自己。

en: Asking for another player's personal details is against the RuneScape Rules of Conduct. Doing so would put your account at risk of being banned.
zh-tw: 詢問另一位玩家的個人資料違反了 RuneScape 行為準則。這樣做會使你的帳號面臨被封鎖的風險。

en: This cheeky gublinch claimed to be a Jagex Moderator! He was reported straight away and dealt with.
zh-tw: 這個厚臉皮的葛布林奇聲稱自己是 Jagex 管理員！他立刻被檢舉並得到了處理。

en: Where should you go in order to read about playing RuneScape safely?
zh-tw: 你應該去哪裡閱讀關於安全遊玩 RuneScape 的資訊？

en: To the 'Safety & Security' section of the RuneScape homepage
zh-tw: 前往 RuneScape 首頁的「安全與保障」區塊

en: Head to the 'Safety & Security' section of the RuneScape Knowledge Base for more information.
zh-tw: 前往 RuneScape 知識庫的「安全與保障」區塊以獲取更多資訊。

en: Actually, there is! A "Play Safely" article can be found in the Safety & Security Guidelines section of the Knowledge Base! We also have pages on player safety, keeping healthy, responsible gaming and account security. If you would like more information, please go to the RuneScape Knowledge Base.
zh-tw: 其實有！在知識庫的「安全與保障指南」區塊可以找到一篇「安全遊玩」的文章！我們也有關於玩家安全、保持健康、負責任遊戲以及帳號安全的頁面。如果你想了解更多資訊，請前往 RuneScape 知識庫。

en: This wretched gublinch was asking a player for his telephone number. The player helped us catch him by refusing to give their information away and reporting the gublinch straight away!
zh-tw: 這個可惡的葛布林奇竟然向玩家索要電話號碼。該玩家透過拒絕提供個人資訊並立即檢舉該葛布林奇，協助我們抓到了他！

en: This foul-mouthed gublinch was flaming and insulting other players. They used the Report Abuse button and he was instantly apprehended.
zh-tw: 這個滿口髒話的葛布林奇正在謾罵並侮辱其他玩家。他們使用了檢舉濫用按鈕，他隨即被逮捕。

en: This vile gublinchette was asking a player for his home address. The clever player didn't give her their address, but used the Report Abuse button to report her instead.
zh-tw: 這個邪惡的葛布林奇女孩竟然向玩家索要住家地址。聰明的玩家沒有給她自己的地址，而是使用檢舉濫用按鈕來檢舉她。

en: How do you report a player for breaking the Rules?
zh-tw: 如何檢舉違反規則的玩家？

en: By using the Report Abuse button at the bottom of my gaming screen
zh-tw: 透過使用遊戲畫面底部的檢舉濫用按鈕

en: I'm not a tell-tale, so I don't report players
zh-tw: 我不是告密者，所以我不會檢舉玩家

en: Find a Moderator and get them to report the player
zh-tw: 尋找管理員並請他們檢舉該玩家

en: You can use the Report Abuse button at the bottom of the game screen,  but make sure you only report players who break the rules.
zh-tw: 你可以使用遊戲畫面底部的檢舉濫用按鈕，但請確保你只檢舉違反規則的玩家。

en: Reporting players who break the Rules allows us to ensure that RuneScape remains a positive and enjoyable environment for everyone. To find out everything you need to know about reporting rulebreakers in RuneScape, please take some time to read the Rules of Conduct and then see our guides on reporting abuse. This can be accessed by clicking on the link: 'Customer Support' on our homepage and then 'Reporting Abuse'.
zh-tw: 檢舉違反規則的玩家能讓我們確保 RuneScape 對每個人來說都是一個積極且愉快的環境。若要了解關於在 RuneScape 中檢舉違規者的所有資訊，請花點時間閱讀行為準則，然後查看我們的檢舉濫用指南。您可以透過點擊我們首頁上的連結「顧客支援」，然後選擇「檢舉濫用」來進行查看。

en: Incorrect. By waiting to find a Moderator, you run the risk of losing the ability to report the player.
zh-tw: 不正確。透過等待尋找管理員，你可能會面臨失去檢舉該玩家能力的風險。

en: A player that you do not know sends you a private message that is offensive. What should you do?
zh-tw: 一位你不認識的玩家傳送了一則冒犯性的私訊給你。你應該怎麼做？

en: Nothing. I can't report anything that is said in private chat
zh-tw: 什麼都不做。我無法檢舉在私人聊天中說過的任何內容

en: Send the player an offensive message back
zh-tw: 回傳一則冒犯性的訊息給該玩家

en: Use the Report Abuse button to report the player and then add them to my Ignore List
zh-tw: 使用檢舉濫用按鈕來檢舉該玩家，然後將其加入我的忽略清單

en: Correct! You can use the Report Abuse button to report any chat that you find offensive, whether it is said in Public or Private Chat. Adding a player to your Ignore List will prevent them from sending you any further messages.
zh-tw: 正確！你可以使用檢舉濫用按鈕來檢舉任何你認為冒犯的對話，無論是在公開聊天還是私人聊天中。將玩家加入你的忽略清單將防止他們再向你傳送任何訊息。

en: Wrong. You can use the Report Abuse button to report any chat that you find offensive, whether it is said in Public or Private Chat.
zh-tw: 錯誤。你可以使用檢舉濫用按鈕來檢舉任何你認為冒犯的對話，無論是在公開聊天還是私人聊天中。

en: Wrong. Retaliating may cause you to get in trouble and be reported yourself!
zh-tw: 錯誤。反擊可能會導致你自己陷入麻煩並被檢舉！

en: This sly gublinch wanted to meet one of his player friends in the real world. The player obviously refused and reported him straight away.
zh-tw: 這個狡猾的葛布林奇想要在現實世界中與他的一位玩家朋友見面。該玩家顯然拒絕了並立即檢舉了他。

en: You are approached in the game by a player named JagMod999. This player claims to be a member of Jagex and asks for your personal details. What should you do?
zh-tw: 在遊戲中，一位名為 JagMod999 的玩家接近你。這位玩家聲稱是 Jagex 的成員，並索要你的個人詳細資料。你應該怎麼做？

en: Do not answer any questions and report the player using the Report Abuse button at the bottom of the game screen
zh-tw: 不要回答任何問題，並使用遊戲畫面底部的檢舉濫用按鈕來檢舉該玩家

en: Give them my details; they are a member of Jagex after all
zh-tw: 把我的詳細資訊給他們；畢竟他們是 Jagex 的成員

en: Correct! A real Jagex Moderator would never ask for a player's personal details. You can always tell who an official moderator is as a gold crown will appear before anything they say in the chat window. If you are at all

en: I should take regular breaks in order to stay healthy
zh-tw: 我應該定期休息以保持健康

en: It's very important to remain healthy by taking regular breaks and spending time doing other activities.
zh-tw: 定期休息並花時間從事其他活動以保持健康是非常重要的。

en: Spending too much time on the computer can be harmful to your health. It's very important to take breaks, exercise and eat properly in order to stay healthy. While it's great to play RuneScape, it's also important to maintain a balanced lifestyle by socialising and spending time away from your computer. For more information, please look at our Responsible Gaming Policy on the RuneScape Knowledge Base.
zh-tw: 在電腦上花太多時間可能會對你的健康有害。為了保持健康，定期休息、運動和適當飲食非常重要。雖然玩 RuneScape 很棒，但透過社交和花時間離開電腦來維持平衡的生活方式也很重要。欲了解更多資訊，請參閱 RuneScape 知識庫中的「負責任遊戲政策」。

en: Wrong. Never give out personal details, such as your full name and date of birth, to other players. Personal details that you give out while chatting could be used by someone so that they can pretend to be you. Use the Report Abuse button to report anyone asking  for your personal details.

en: Deposit beast of burden inventory: If you have a Summoning familiar or other follower with you that is carrying items, clicking this button will transfer everything it is carrying into your bank (space permitting).
zh-tw: 存入負重生物物品欄：如果你身邊有攜帶物品的召喚僕從或其他追隨者，點擊此按鈕將會把牠們攜帶的所有物品轉移到你的銀行中（視空間是否允許）。

en: Search: Clicking this button will switch your bank to the main tab and open a search box. Type the name of the item you are looking for and it will narrow down your banked items as you type. (Note: don't worry, your other items aren't disappearing, they're just being removed from the current search and are still in your bank.)
zh-tw: 搜尋：點擊此按鈕會將你的銀行切換至主分頁並開啟搜尋框。輸入你正在尋找的物品名稱，它會在您輸入時縮小搜尋範圍。（便條：別擔心，您的其他物品並未消失，它們只是從目前的搜尋結果中移除，仍保存在您的銀行中。）

en: Across the bottom of the bank there are some other features, which, from left to right, are:
zh-tw: 在銀行的底部還有一些其他功能，從左到右分別是：

en: Swap/insert: Clicking this button toggles how items are rearranged in your bank. `Swap' mode means that the item you drag and the item it is dragged over will swap places in your bank. `Insert' mode allows you to place an item in a specific bank slot, shifting other items over to make room.
zh-tw: 交換/插入：點擊此按鈕可切換物品在銀行中的重新排列方式。「交換」模式意味著你拖動的物品與被拖動到的物品會在銀行中互換位置。「插入」模式則允許你將物品放置在特定的銀行欄位，並將其他物品移開以騰出空間。

en: Item/note withdrawal: Clicking this button toggles how you withdraw items from your bank. `Item' mode places the actual item in your inventory; `Note' mode places a `noted' version of that object in your inventory. A note is worth the exact same value as the item it depicts, but is not the item itself and cannot be used as such. Notes are typically used for trading in bulk, as noted items can be stacked even if the actual item can not be.
zh-tw: 物品/便條提領：點擊此按鈕可切換從銀行提領物品的方式。「物品」模式會將實際的物品放入你的物品欄；「便條」模式則會將該物件的「便條化」版本放入你的物品欄。一個便條與其所代表的物品具有完全相同的價值，但它本身並非該物品，也不能作為該物品使用。便條通常用於大量交易，因為即使實際物品無法堆疊，便條化的物品也可以堆疊。

en: Using this tab system will allow you to easily group together related items as you wish. For instance, you could place all of your food in one tab, or all of your weapons in another. Alternatively, you could create a tab to contain all of those items you use to train a skill or play a certain minigame. There is no limit to the number of times you can rearrange your bank, so feel free to experiment.
zh-tw: 使用此分頁系統可以讓你根據意願輕鬆地將相關物品歸類。例如，你可以將所有的食物放在一個分頁中，或將所有的武器放在另一個分頁中。或者，你可以建立一個分頁來存放所有用於訓練技能或進行特定小遊戲的物品。重新排列銀行的次數沒有限制，所以請隨意進行實驗。

en: At the top-right corner of the bank you will see two numbers. The top number displays the total number of items in your bank; the bottom number displays the total amount of bank space available to you.
zh-tw: 在銀行的右上角你會看到兩個數字。上方數字顯示你銀行中的物品總數；下方數字顯示你可以使用的銀行空間總量。

en: The Bank of RuneScape is a great place to keep all of your belongings safe. The bank has branches all over RuneScape, so you're never very far away from your possessions.
zh-tw: RuneScape 銀行是存放所有財物安全的好地方。銀行在整個 RuneScape 到處都有分行，所以你的財產永遠不會離你太遠。

en: The tab furthest to the left is the main bank tab (pictured left). The main tab will always display the entire contents of your bank account, but you can also create up to eight other tabs in which to categorise your banked items.
zh-tw: 最左側的分頁是主銀行分頁（如左圖所示）。主分頁將始終顯示你銀行帳戶的所有內容，但你也可以建立最多另外八個分頁來對你的銀行物品進行分類。

en: To create a new tab, simply drag any item in your bank on to the 'plus' tab (pictured right). You can then drag as many other items as you want on to this new tab. Clicking on a tab other than the main one will show you only those items you have placed within it. The icon used to mark each new tab is taken from the first item within that tab.
zh-tw: 若要建立新分頁，只需將銀行中的任何物品拖動到「加號」分頁上（如右圖所示）。接著你可以根據需要將任意數量的其他物品拖動到這個新分頁中。點擊除主分頁以外的分頁時，將只顯示你放置在其中的物品。用於標記每個新分頁的圖示取自該分頁中的第一個物品。
